mechanism: Piroxicam may inhibit renal clearance of chlorpromazine and both drugs increase GI bleeding risk; chlorpromazine may increase NSAID-induced gastric ulceration through anticholinergic effects and reduced gastric motility.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine toxicity (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms) and GI bleeding; consider gastroprotection; use alternative NSAID or analgesic if possible.
